builds.name: Despair: four seconds of target-health damage
builds.summary: Investigate high four seconds of Despair core magic damage output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high four seconds of Despair core magic damage output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The tooltip gives 10 flat magic damage plus (1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 + 0.005 AP)% enemy maximum HP per second. Rank 5 over four seconds nominally totals 40 plus (8 + 0.02 AP)% target maximum HP, before tick boundaries and mitigation. AP increases a target-health coefficient as well as item effects; this is not 0.5% per AP.
